note: Türkiye: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for business and tourism, 90 days in any 180 for most, 60 a stay for Russia, 30 a stay for Brunei, Costa Rica, Indonesia, Macao, Mongolia, Thailand and Belarus (within 90 in 180, or a year for Belarus: not modelled); Northern Cyprus's citizens without limit (no country on the map). Nationals of the countries listed for the e-Visa apply online (up to 90 days in 180; some single-entry 30 days). Those on the conditional e-Visa list (Afghanistan, Algeria, Bangladesh, Egypt, India, Iraq, Pakistan, the Philippines and others) need a Schengen, Irish, UK or US visa or residence and other conditions, and everyone else a visa from a mission: both taken as a visa. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs' and the e-Visa sites refuse this client, so the lists are read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Turkey
sources.said: Citizens of the following countries and territories may enter Turkey without a visa for business and tourist purposes for stays up to the duration listed below. ... 90 days within any 180 days European Union member states (except Cyprus) Albania Andorra Argentina Australia Azerbaijan Bahrain Belize Bolivia Bosnia and Herzegovina Brazil Canada Chile China Colombia Ecuador El Salvador Georgia Guatemala Honduras Hong Kong Iceland Iran Israel Japan Jordan Kazakhstan Kosovo Kuwait Kyrgyzstan Lebanon Liechtenstein Malaysia Moldova Monaco Montenegro Morocco New Zealand Nicaragua North Macedonia Norway Oman Panama Paraguay Peru Qatar San Marino Saudi Arabia Serbia Seychelles Singapore South Korea Switzerland Trinidad and Tobago Tunisia Ukraine United Arab Emirates United Kingdom United States Uruguay Uzbekistan Vatican City Venezuela 60 days per entry, 90 days within any 180 days Russia 30 days per entry, 90 days within any 180 days Brunei Costa Rica Indonesia Macau Mongolia Thailand 30 days per entry, 90 days within any 1 year Belarus ... Citizens of the following countries and territories are required visas to enter Turkey. However they may apply for an electronic visa (e-Visa) for short term visits. Electronic visas may be issued with duration of stay for up to 90 days with multiple entries (unless otherwise noted) in any 180 days. Visitors are not permitted to work and recourse to public funds.
